name: Warp-Space Affine Mixture
definition: A warping method where the affine mixture weights are computed in warped space, outperforming models with no warping, convolutional warps, or world-space mixture.
summary: Warp-Space Affine Mixture computes affine mixture weights in warped space to produce an inverse warp field, outperforming world-space or no-warping models.
